module purpose: neorv32_twd is a two-wire bus device (target) controller: a bus-written control word (enable, sampling-frequency select, own 7-bit device address, interrupt enables, TX-dummy enable, read hiding, FIFO clear commands) and a data port to an RX FIFO and a TX FIFO; it samples twd_sda_i and twd_scl_i, detects SCL edges and START/STOP conditions, runs a state machine that matches the received address against ctrl.device_addr, shifts received bytes into the RX FIFO and transmits TX FIFO bytes (or a backup byte) on twd_sda_o, and raises irq_o from enabled FIFO conditions.

use-case flows.value: control settings (enable, fsel, device_addr, irq enables, tx_dummy_en, hide_read) and FIFO clear commands written from bus write data on a control-word write
a byte written by the bus into the TX FIFO on a data-port write
stored control settings, FIFO size constants, FIFO and line status, busy flag, and an RX FIFO byte returned on a bus read (the data-port read also pops the RX FIFO)
a START condition on the lines starts an addressed transfer when the controller is enabled
address phase: address byte shifted in, compared with the device address, read/write bit captured, acknowledge driven on SDA
receive: data bits shifted in from SDA and the completed byte written into the RX FIFO unless it is full, then acknowledged
transmit: TX FIFO byte (or backup byte, or all ones) loaded and shifted out on SDA, master acknowledge sampled, TX FIFO popped
line sampling at the selected rate and bus-event detection (SCL rise and fall, START, STOP)
interrupt request from enabled FIFO conditions, and status bits (FIFO flags, sensed lines, busy)
rstn_i clears control, backup, interrupt, sampling, event and engine registers; disable or a clear command flushes the FIFOs; clear commands self-clear each cycle

conceptual assets.concept: Controller enable -- whether the device engine, line sampling, FIFOs and interrupt are active
conceptual assets.reasoning: The configure flow stores it: ctrl.enable <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_en_c) (line 159, CLOCKED_BY clk_i at occurrence 3; reset to '0' at line 138). Behavior depends on it: it forces both FIFO clears (lines 230, 281), gates sampling and sets the line shift registers to ones when low (lines 315-323), gates START acceptance and every return to S_IDLE (lines 381, 389, 397, 421, 434, 465), gates irq_o (line 293), and is exported by clkgen_en_o <= ctrl.enable (line 198). Integrity is Established because a wrong value changes all of these decisions. Availability is also Established: while it is '0' the FIFOs are held clear and the engine returns to S_IDLE, so no transfer completes. ctrl.enable stores it; clkgen_en_o is the exit port (COPIES ctrl.enable, occurrence 2). The write is decided by bus_req_i fields and read back on bus_rsp_o.data (line 172); both are transport records, so neither is a reference.

conceptual assets.concept: Own device address and the address-match acceptance decision -- whether the device answers an addressed transfer
conceptual assets.reasoning: ctrl.device_addr is stored from bus write data (line 163, CLOCKED_BY clk_i at occurrence 3; reset at line 142). In S_ADDR, after the address byte (engine.cnt(3) = '1' and smp.scl_fall = '1', line 401), if (ctrl.device_addr = engine.sreg(7 downto 1)) (line 402) moves engine.state to S_RESP (line 406; CONSTRAINED_BY ctrl.device_addr at occurrence 10), and in S_RESP twd_sda_o <= '0' (line 418; SELECTED_BY engine.state at occurrence 4) drives the acknowledge out of the entity. Integrity is Established: a wrong stored address or a wrong match result makes the device acknowledge a transfer for another address or ignore its own. ctrl.device_addr stores the setting; engine.state computes the acceptance (it is also the sequencing state, reported separately); twd_sda_o is the exit port of the acknowledge. engine.sreg is the compared operand, not the result.

conceptual assets.concept: Read-request hiding policy -- whether a read addressed to the device is ignored under the stated TX FIFO condition
conceptual assets.reasoning: ctrl.hide_read is stored from bus write data (line 168, CLOCKED_BY clk_i at occurrence 3; reset at line 147). On an address match, if (engine.sreg(0) = '1' and (ctrl.hide_read = '1' and (tx_fifo.free = '0'))) sends engine.state to S_IDLE instead of S_RESP (lines 403-406; GATED_BY ctrl.hide_read at occurrence 9), so no acknowledge is driven. Integrity is Established: the stored policy decides whether a read request is acknowledged. ctrl.hide_read stores the policy and engine.state computes the resulting decision. The condition tests tx_fifo.free exactly as written at line 403.

conceptual assets.concept: Interrupt source enables -- which FIFO conditions may raise the interrupt
conceptual assets.reasoning: ctrl.irq_rx_avail, ctrl.irq_rx_full and ctrl.irq_tx_empty are stored from bus write data (lines 164-166, CLOCKED_BY clk_i at occurrence 3 each; reset at lines 143-145) and read back (lines 175-177, transport). They select the conditions of irq_o <= ctrl.enable and ((ctrl.irq_rx_avail and rx_fifo.avail) or (ctrl.irq_rx_full and (not rx_fifo.free)) or (ctrl.irq_tx_empty and (not tx_fifo.avail))) (lines 293-296; each SOURCES irq_o at occurrence 5). Integrity is Established: a wrong enable raises an interrupt for a disabled condition or suppresses an enabled one.

conceptual assets.concept: Interrupt request -- the event the module signals when an enabled FIFO condition holds
conceptual assets.reasoning: irq_o is computed and registered by lines 293-296 (CLOCKED_BY clk_i, reset to '0' at line 291) and leaves the entity through its own port. Integrity is Established: the consumer outside this entity must receive exactly ctrl.enable and the OR of the enabled conditions (lines 293-296). Availability is also Established under the implemented condition: while the controller is enabled and an enabled condition holds, irq_o is '1' after each rising edge of clk_i. irq_o is the exit port (DERIVES_FROM ctrl.irq_rx_avail at occurrence 3), ahead of its overlapping storage role.

conceptual assets.concept: FIFO clear commands and flush decisions -- when the RX and TX FIFO contents are discarded
conceptual assets.reasoning: ctrl.clr_rx and ctrl.clr_tx are stored from bus write data (lines 160-161, CLOCKED_BY clk_i at occurrence 4) and set back to '0' every cycle (lines 154-155), so each is a one-cycle command. rx_fifo.clr <= '1' when (ctrl.enable = '0') or (ctrl.clr_rx = '1') else '0' (line 281) and tx_fifo.clr (line 230) compute the flush decision here and deliver it to clear_i of the FIFO sub-units (lines 217, 268). Integrity is Established from those delivering lines: each FIFO must receive exactly this decision. Availability is also Established: an asserted clear discards buffered bytes. The sub-unit wiring exception holds for rx_fifo.clr and tx_fifo.clr because each is computed here from a decision (GATED_BY at occurrence 3).

conceptual assets.concept: Bus access decisions of this block -- control-word write, TX FIFO push and RX FIFO pop
conceptual assets.reasoning: tx_fifo.we <= '1' when (bus_req_i.stb = '1') and (bus_req_i.rw = '1') and (bus_req_i.addr(2) = '1') (line 231) and rx_fifo.re for a read of the same address (line 284) compute the push and pop decisions here (GATED_BY bus_req_i.stb at occurrence 3) and deliver them to we_i and re_i of the FIFO sub-units (lines 222, 276). Integrity is Established from those lines: a FIFO must push or pop exactly on a qualified data-port access. The control-word write is decided inline by bus_req_i fields (lines 156-158) and has no separate element; bus_req_i is a transport record, so it is not a setting point. tx_fifo.wdata only passes bus data unchanged into the sub-unit (line 232), so it is a carrier.

conceptual assets.concept: Sampling-frequency selection -- the rate at which the bus lines are sampled
conceptual assets.reasoning: ctrl.fsel is stored from bus write data (line 162, CLOCKED_BY clk_i at occurrence 3) and read back (line 173). smp.clk_en <= clkgen_i(clk_div64_c) when (ctrl.fsel = '1') else clkgen_i(clk_div8_c) (line 329) gates sampling and smp.valid (lines 316-319), which qualifies every bus event (lines 344-347). Integrity is Established: the setting decides the sampling rate that the event detection and the engine depend on. ctrl.fsel stores it. clkgen_i only supplies clock-enable ticks, and smp.clk_en only forwards the selected tick and gates, so neither is a reference.

conceptual assets.concept: Transmit-underflow response policy -- what is sent when the TX FIFO is empty
conceptual assets.reasoning: ctrl.tx_dummy_en is stored from bus write data (line 167, CLOCKED_BY clk_i at occurrence 3) and read back (line 178). engine.rdata <= tx_fifo.rdata when (tx_fifo.avail = '1') else tx_dummy when (ctrl.tx_dummy_en = '1') else (others => '1') (lines 250-252; GATES engine.rdata at occurrence 5) decides which byte the transmit flow sends on underflow. Integrity is Established: a wrong setting changes the transmitted byte.

conceptual assets.concept: Transmit data -- the byte sent to the bus master during a read transfer
conceptual assets.reasoning: engine.rdata selects the byte to send (lines 250-252; DERIVES_FROM tx_fifo.rdata at occurrence 2). It is loaded into engine.sreg and engine.dout (lines 428-429 and 463-464), shifted bit by bit (line 456) and driven by twd_sda_o <= engine.dout while engine.cmd = '1' (lines 453-454; COPIES engine.dout at occurrence 5). tx_dummy keeps the last byte popped from the TX FIFO (lines 241-242, CLOCKED_BY clk_i at occurrence 3) and is the substitute at line 251. Integrity is Established: the bits leaving on twd_sda_o must equal the selected byte, in order. engine.rdata computes; tx_dummy, engine.sreg (occurrence 10, line 428) and engine.dout (occurrence 3, line 429) store; twd_sda_o is the exit port. tx_fifo.rdata only receives the sub-unit output and forwards it (lines 226, 242, 250) without being tested, so it is a carrier.

conceptual assets.concept: Received data -- the byte written by the bus master into the device
conceptual assets.reasoning: twd_sda_i is sampled into smp.sda_sreg(0) (line 311; SOURCES smp.sda_sreg at occurrence 2), shifted (line 318), reduced to smp.sda (line 342), shifted into engine.sreg on each SCL rise (line 449, CLOCKED_BY clk_i at occurrence 11) and written into the RX FIFO by rx_fifo.wdata <= engine.sreg (line 282) when engine.wr_we is set (lines 283, 443). Integrity is Established from those delivering lines: the RX FIFO must receive exactly the shifted-in byte. twd_sda_i sets it because this entity reads it to store it; smp.sda_sreg, smp.sda and engine.sreg store it. rx_fifo.wdata copies engine.sreg into the sub-unit and rx_fifo.rdata only carries the sub-unit output to the transport port (line 190), so both are carriers.

conceptual assets.concept: Engine-side FIFO access decisions -- commit a received byte to the RX FIFO, pop the TX FIFO after a master acknowledge
conceptual assets.reasoning: In S_RTX at the byte end, if (engine.cmd = '0' and rx_fifo.free = '0') the byte is dropped and the engine returns to S_IDLE (lines 439-441); otherwise engine.wr_we <= not engine.cmd (line 443, CLOCKED_BY clk_i at occurrence 6). In S_ACK, engine.rd_re <= '1' when engine.cmd = '1', smp.scl_rise = '1' and smp.sda = '0' (lines 477-478, CLOCKED_BY clk_i at occurrence 6); it also gates the tx_dummy capture (line 241). The decisions reach we_i and re_i of the FIFO sub-units through rx_fifo.we (line 283) and tx_fifo.re (line 233). Integrity is Established from those delivering lines. Availability is also Established: a byte that arrives while the RX FIFO is full is not stored (line 441). engine.wr_we and engine.rd_re store the decisions (registered); rx_fifo.we and tx_fifo.re only copy them into the sub-units, so they are carriers.

conceptual assets.concept: Two-wire bus events -- SCL rising and falling edges and START and STOP conditions
conceptual assets.reasoning: twd_scl_i is sampled into smp.scl_sreg (line 312; SOURCES smp.scl_sreg at occurrence 2) and shifted (line 319). smp.scl_rise, smp.scl_fall, smp.start and smp.stop are computed from the shifted samples, qualified by smp.valid (lines 344-347; CLOCKED_BY clk_i at occurrence 3 each); smp.sda_sreg (reported under received data) supplies the SDA operand of START and STOP. Every engine transition, shift and acknowledge sample depends on them (lines 381, 389, 397-401, 411, 423, 427, 434-438, 448, 455, 465-467, 473, 477). Integrity is Established: a wrong event starts, aborts or mis-clocks a transfer. twd_scl_i sets the events because this entity reads it to store it; the shift register and the four event registers store them. smp.valid only gates the event logic.

conceptual assets.concept: Transfer sequencing state -- the engine protocol state and its bit counter
conceptual assets.reasoning: engine.state is the self-selecting state register of case engine.state (line 377) over S_IDLE, S_INIT, S_ADDR, S_RESP, S_RTX and S_ACK (lines 382-487, CLOCKED_BY clk_i at occurrence 4; reset to S_IDLE at line 359; when others returns to S_IDLE at line 487). It selects SDA driving, shifting and the FIFO write and pop pulses (SELECTS records at occurrence 3). engine.cnt counts bits (lines 413, 450, CLOCKED_BY clk_i at occurrence 5) and engine.cnt(3) marks the byte end (lines 401, 438). Integrity is Established: a wrong state or count misplaces acknowledges, data bits and FIFO writes. Availability is also Established under the implemented conditions: each START with the controller enabled leaves S_IDLE (line 381), and a STOP or disable returns to S_IDLE.

conceptual assets.concept: Transfer direction -- whether the addressed transfer is a read or a write
conceptual assets.reasoning: engine.cmd <= engine.sreg(0) in S_RESP (line 420, CLOCKED_BY clk_i at occurrence 3) captures the direction bit of the address byte. It decides whether the device transmits (lines 453-456), commits received bytes (lines 439-443), drives the data acknowledge (lines 481-482), continues after an acknowledge (line 468) and pops the TX FIFO (line 477). Integrity is Established: a wrong direction sends data on a write or stores data on a read. engine.cmd stores it.

conceptual assets.concept: Master acknowledge of a transmitted byte -- whether a read transfer continues
conceptual assets.reasoning: engine.ack <= smp.sda on an SCL rise in S_ACK (lines 473-474, CLOCKED_BY clk_i at occurrence 4). In S_ACK, if (engine.cmd = '0') or ((engine.cmd = '1') and (engine.ack = '0')) the engine returns to S_RTX for the next byte (lines 468-469; GATES engine.state at occurrence 3). Integrity is Established: the captured acknowledge decides whether transmission continues. engine.ack stores it.

conceptual assets.concept: Device status on a control read -- sensed line levels and the busy flag
conceptual assets.reasoning: A control read returns smp.scl (line 186), smp.sda (line 187) and engine.busy (line 188) through bus_rsp_o.data. engine.busy <= '0' when (engine.state = S_IDLE) else '1' (line 494; GATED_BY engine.state at occurrence 3) computes the busy status. smp.scl is stored at line 343 (CLOCKED_BY clk_i at occurrence 4); as written, its value is computed from smp.sda_sreg(2) or smp.sda_sreg(1), the same operands as smp.sda (line 342). Integrity is Established from the delivering lines: the reader must receive exactly the values these lines define. The exit is bus_rsp_o, a transport record, so it is not a reference.

conceptual assets.concept: FIFO fill status used for flow control -- RX FIFO full, TX FIFO data available and TX FIFO full
conceptual assets.reasoning: The FIFO sub-units drive rx_fifo.free (line 274), tx_fifo.avail (line 227) and tx_fifo.free (line 223); their internals are not supplied. This entity tests each one in a condition: rx_fifo.free drops a received byte when the FIFO is full (line 439), tx_fifo.avail chooses FIFO data over the substitute (line 250) and qualifies the tx_dummy capture (line 241), and tx_fifo.free is part of the read-hiding condition (line 403). They also feed irq_o (lines 295-296) and status bits (lines 183-185). Integrity is Established from the receiving lines: these decisions require exactly the status the sub-units deliver. Each enters through a CONNECTS edge of mode out (occurrence 3), so the sub-unit wiring exception is met. rx_fifo.avail is only read as data (lines 182, 294), so it is a carrier.
